envelope.note: Invalid because the named command does not exit 0. The failing test is test_pr_head_expected.CollectJudgesEachPrAgainstItsOwnHead.setUpClass. Commit creation was denied by the read-only Git sandbox, so out/COMMIT_MSG and the commit envelope are provided. Even after simulating that commit, the immutable fixture runs `git add -A -- .github .dev` in a tree exported only from `.github/workflows` and `ops/devlane/workflow`; `.dev` is absent and Git exits 128. Editing that test is forbidden. Assumption: wf.py restores only the read-only check-registry projection because the surrounding contract explicitly keeps the state-machine runtime absent. Follow-up: the passing suites repeatedly report pre-existing ResourceWarnings for live subprocesses and an unclosed file; these were not changed.

commit.body:
Accept verified launcher collections when landing tripped write jobs.
Keep isolated pull-request check failures as cannot-tell rows, restore
the tracked check-registry projection, and provide the workflow inputs
used to derive each PR head's expected contexts.
